company_name: Inner Mongolia OJing Science & Technology Co.,Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — OJing specializes in the manufacture of quartz crucibles, which are essential for the production of semiconductor ingots.
summary: Inner Mongolia OJing Science & Technology Co., Ltd is a professional manufacturer of quartz crucibles, primarily used in the mono pulling process for semiconductor and solar applications. The company offers a range of crucible sizes and has significant production capacity to meet industry demands.
capabilities: Support for N-type mono quality requirements

regional_presence.China: The company is located in Hohhot, Inner Mongolia, where it operates its manufacturing facilities.
